# Text form

Reading and writing a UUID in its canonical and URN text forms.

<h2 id="uuid-text-length"><code>UuidTextLength</code></h2>

```rux
pub const UuidTextLength: uint = 36;
```

How long the canonical text form is: thirty-two digits and four hyphens.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Uuid/Src/Text.rux#L28)

<h2 id="uuid-urn-length"><code>UuidUrnLength</code></h2>

```rux
pub const UuidUrnLength: uint = 45;
```

How long the URN form is: the canonical form after `urn:uuid:`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Uuid/Src/Text.rux#L32)

<h2 id="uuid-parse-error"><code>UuidParseError</code></h2>

```rux
pub variant UuidParseError {
    WrongLength(uint),
    Misplaced(uint),
    NotHexadecimal(uint),
    BadPrefix(uint)
}
```

Why text could not be read as a UUID.
Failure-only: every case is a failure, and each carries the zero-based UTF-8 byte offset into the text where it
was found. Success is the other channel of `Uuid ! UuidParseError`, so there is no case here meaning nothing went
wrong.
Copy, carrying one offset and owning nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Uuid/Src/Text.rux#L40)

**Cases**

| Name                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `WrongLength(uint)`    | The text is neither thirty-six characters nor forty-five with the URN prefix. The offset is the text's length when it is too short, which is where the missing character would have gone, and the first character the canonical form has no room for when it is too long. |
| `Misplaced(uint)`      | A hyphen is missing where the form puts one, or one appears where a digit belongs. The offset is that character.                                                                                                                                                          |
| `NotHexadecimal(uint)` | A character that is not a hexadecimal digit. The offset is that character.                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `BadPrefix(uint)`      | The text has the length of the URN form but its `urn:uuid:` prefix is misspelled. The offset is the first character that does not match.                                                                                                                                  |

**Implements ParseFailure**

`UuidParseError` conforms to `ParseFailure`.

<h3 id="uuid-parse-error-offset"><code>Offset</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Offset(self: &UuidParseError) -> uint
```

Where in the input the failure was found.
Borrows the error and leaves it untouched. Cannot fail; runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

**Returns**: the zero-based UTF-8 byte offset, which is the text's length at end of input

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Uuid/Src/Text.rux#L60)

<h2 id="parse"><code>Parse</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Parse(text: char8[..]) -> Uuid ! UuidParseError
pub func Parse(text: StringView) -> Uuid ! UuidParseError
```

Reads a UUID from its canonical or URN text form.
Both cases of the digits are accepted, because the standard says the two mean the same thing; nothing else is.
The URN prefix is compared case-insensitively, which is RFC 8141's rule for a scheme name and a different rule
from the digits — both are the standard's.
Reports `WrongLength` for text that is neither form's length, `BadPrefix` for a misspelled `urn:uuid:`,
`Misplaced` for a hyphen that is missing or one that stands where a digit belongs, and `NotHexadecimal` for any
other character that is not a digit. Each carries the byte offset into `text` where it was found. A refused
parse produces no value at all rather than a half-filled one.

| Overload                                                    | Summary                                            |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Parse(text: char8[..]) -> Uuid ! UuidParseError`  | Reads a UUID from its canonical or URN text form.  |
| `pub func Parse(text: StringView) -> Uuid ! UuidParseError` | Reads a UUID from the text a `StringView` borrows. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Uuid/Src/Text.rux#L94)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type                       | Description      |
| ------ | -------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `text` | `char8[..]` / `StringView` | the text to read |

**Returns**: the identifier, or why the text is not one

<h2 id="format"><code>Format</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Format(value: &Uuid, into: var char8[..]) -> ! FormatError
```

Writes the canonical text form into `into`, in lower case.
Lower case because RFC 9562 says so, and because a canonical form that varies by case is not canonical — two
systems comparing text would disagree about equal UUIDs.
Reports `InsufficientCapacity` when `into` is shorter than [`UuidTextLength`](/docs/api/uuid/text#uuid-text-length), leaving it exactly as it was. A
short destination is refused rather than filled with what fits, because a truncated UUID is a different string
rather than a shorter one. Room past the thirty-six characters is not touched.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Uuid/Src/Text.rux#L198)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                              |
| ------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value` | `&Uuid`         | the identifier to write                                                                  |
| `into`  | `var char8[..]` | the destination, at least [`UuidTextLength`](/docs/api/uuid/text#uuid-text-length) bytes |

**Returns**: success when the whole form was written

<h2 id="format-upper"><code>FormatUpper</code></h2>

```rux
pub func FormatUpper(value: &Uuid, into: var char8[..]) -> ! FormatError
```

Writes the canonical text form into `into`, in upper case.
Offered because some formats demand it; [`Format`](/docs/api/uuid/text#format) is what a program should write when it has the choice.
The failure [`Format`](/docs/api/uuid/text#format) reports, for the same reason and with the same guarantee.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Uuid/Src/Text.rux#L211)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                              |
| ------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value` | `&Uuid`         | the identifier to write                                                                  |
| `into`  | `var char8[..]` | the destination, at least [`UuidTextLength`](/docs/api/uuid/text#uuid-text-length) bytes |

**Returns**: success when the whole form was written

<h2 id="format-urn"><code>FormatUrn</code></h2>

```rux
pub func FormatUrn(value: &Uuid, into: var char8[..]) -> ! FormatError
```

Writes the URN form into `into`: the canonical form after `urn:uuid:`.
Reports `InsufficientCapacity` when `into` is shorter than [`UuidUrnLength`](/docs/api/uuid/text#uuid-urn-length), leaving it exactly as it was. The
form is refused whole, so a destination never receives a prefix with nothing after it.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Uuid/Src/Text.rux#L232)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                            |
| ------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value` | `&Uuid`         | the identifier to write                                                                |
| `into`  | `var char8[..]` | the destination, at least [`UuidUrnLength`](/docs/api/uuid/text#uuid-urn-length) bytes |

**Returns**: success when the whole form was written
